notes.title: The Deck of Sailors - Setting Sail!
notes.content:
[h1]Ahoy there![/h1]
[i][b]Since Nintendo wouldn't take my game for the Switch, I've brought The Caribbean Sail to paper instead![/b][/i]

"Just a card deck?" I hear you mutter with a twinge of curiosity tainted by a drop of waning disappointment. Nay! Banish those doubts and behold the infomercial!

[previewyoutube=iw_yI064gsU;full][/previewyoutube]
There we are. Now that I've got your attention, here's what you can find in the box!

[b]Deluxe Deck[/b] - 90 cards in total. Major and Minor Arcana, Jokers, and bonus cards.
[b]Minor Arcana[/b] - Coins, skulls, hearts, and swords.
[b]Major Arcana[/b] - 22 unique poker size tarot cards labeled by roman numeral.
[b]Bonuses[/b] - 2 game cards, 4 mysterious red aces, a tarot reference card, and more!

If that doesn't have you reaching for your wallet, how about a tarot cloth for divination... or just making it easier to pick up cards off of hard surfaces like your heart?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30575242/cc5b7a5efec8988865f5e13d7a84d689cec2c2ac.jpg[/img]
Made from the finest sail cloth I could sink my hooks into.

While supplies last, you can also get my name fancifully written on a card by yours truly! 
Half were gone in the first hour so I doubt this illustrious privilege will last much longer. 
It may even be worth something when I'm dead!

Now stop listening to my blathering and go plunder yourself a Deck of Sailors!
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/victorianclambake/deck-of-sailors]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/victorianclambake/deck-of-sailors[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30575242/71bcc183143a38b8e80d24d53747ab0fc916a6fd.jpg[/img]

Thank you for enduring the written medium and supporting the physical medium.

Fair winds to you all lads!

notes.title: The Deck of Sailors
notes.content:
[h1]Happy Seventh Anniversary to The Caribbean Sail![/h1]

After years of being restrained to only the darkest corners of taverns, those tarot cards are coming to the real world along with a full deck of playing cards styled in the black and white pixels of The Caribbean Sail!

[previewyoutube=FkzyRKj5ev4;full][/previewyoutube]

You could read fortunes... or you could play a game of gin rummy, poker, bull***t, scopa, or [url=https://victorianclambake.com/cardgame]The Hunt for Davy Jones![/url] -and by Neptune, why stop there? Invent your own card games with the custom suits!

[h2]Coins[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30575242/9e676441f062dcfb4b0d113c7f3e571c00f32c53.png[/img]

[h2]Swords[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30575242/aa5561e52d3677b525698086cb71c72e8de15616.png[/img]

[h2]Hearts[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30575242/a179e7e41842cc77bfcec79994067d3434bf6156.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30575242/25b3928e3355022f8d1754b137c63e7708d9e8b1.png[/img]

You've never seen a card deck like this and you likely never will again. These won't be none of your cabin boys flat sticky flimsy paper cards neither, nay, I'm having them printed on the air cushioned M32* linen stock that dreams are made from which cardistry experts and magicians would be proud to wield.

Get notified when the Kickstarter goes live [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/victorianclambake/deck-of-sailors] here![/url]

[h1]Seven years. Wow.[/h1]
Talk like a pirate day 2017 was the initial release date of these piratey pixels and I never thought that I'd still be passionate about making new artwork or pushing content updates all this time later but [b]you[/b] keep me motivated.

Thank you kindly for all your support over the years and bringing my dreams to life time and time again. Raise a drink to yourselves lads as we look forward to another year of Caribbean Sailing!
 - The Captain, Evan Massie

notes.title: [ENDED] New Merch Store!
notes.content:
[h2]You know what every good pirate needs? Cannons.[/h2]
[The Merch store is no longer live - Event ended]

Unfortunately those are hard to make, ship, or sell online so I've created the next best thing: A limited time merch store!

[url=vcmerch.com][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30575242/c8c11794249a02cba622234ea08ae65508abfe1c.png[/img][/url]

Hosted by shopify and printed by printful (not painstakingly handcrafted as usual) all high enough quality for this Captain's standards!

[url=https://vcmerch.com/products/pixel-pad][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30575242/895522f03ff11fddb175969416fe47aaf645929a.jpg[/img][/url]

The desk pad is my personal favorite. There's no branding which makes it versatile! Use it as a giant mouse pad, a game mat to make cards easier to pick up (Try [url=https://victorianclambake.com/cardgame]my card game[/url] on it), make your coworkers jealous, organize your crew rations on it, make it into a rum coaster for your table, roll it up and smack away seagulls, wrap yourself in it for warmth as the cruel winds blow down from the north- the possibilities are endless!

[url=https://vcmerch.com/products/joyless-roger-stealth][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30575242/8c21d19e5361f8c5ef5c7f2ab01a2c4163a7cdf0.png[/img][/url]

My second favorite piece is the Joyless Roger stealth shirt! Black printed on black is obviously the coolest possible cooler combination and it doesn't come cooler than this. The subtle design without branding makes it a flexible base piece for any everyday pirate looking to show their true colors.

[h2]On limited quantities[/h2]
There's a few other items on the store but all are currently limited to only 10 units available in total per size, per item, shipping in USA only. I don't plan on staying in the merch business forever at this time so fetch yer swag and toss a few doubloons my way because this whole ship will sink in January 2024. 

If things go well I may replenish stock in December, create more designs, more products, or other things... like a sheet of Caribbean Sail themed stickers. I'm testing new waters so we'll see where they take us!

[h1]That's all well and good Captain but where's our next game?[/h1]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2153250/Captain_Blacksword/]Captain Blacksword[/url] is underway lads and I'm sharing updates regularly on the [url=discord.gg/clambake]Discord[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/Tophat_Scallop]Twitter (or X marks the spot if you prefer)[/url] and cross posting to a strange little website called [url=https://www.stimulus.com/tophat_scallop]Stimulus[/url].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30575242/424f3382787a9c57ab6831e90617ae9d6f9d30e3.jpg[/img]

WHAT THE DEVIL IS THAT?

Since you asked and it no longer feels like I'm cornering you to talk about my endless passion projects apropos of nothing; I went an extra nautical mile as Captain Blacksword is intended to be an NES style arcade game and built my own tabletop arcade machine. I'm working on an arcade compatible demo to run that will be downloadable on my [url=https://ko-fi.com/victorianclambake]Kofi page[/url] for the Clambake Crew members.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30575242/dc10a3419b7bd7f9e04fb018927b6fcaa0a5c2c0.gif[/img]

Captain Blacksword has been in a toybox phase for longer than you've been ignoring the barnacles on your hull and as of today is now on course for completion. Feature creep has bogged things down long enough and I'm focused on creating levels. What lies before me is an estimated 100 days of work. Not days until release, 24 hour periods of solid development. Blacksword will not release until it has achieved 10,000 wishlists even if the game is 100% complete. This ship will sail or stay in port until I figure out how to create the wind myself.

As a final announcement...

[h2]There will be one more Caribbean Sail feature.[/h2]
I am legally obligated not to disclose what it will be until January 1st.

[h3]Fair winds to you all lads!
 - Evan, Captain of Victorian Clambake[/h3]

notes.title: The Caribbean Sail - Fifth Anniversary!
notes.content:
[h1]Five years ago on September 19th, The Caribbean Sail was released.[/h1]

Since that day, The Caribbean Sail has seen numerous updates, two major expansion packs released for free, a shanty off contest, a soundtrack release, a successful Kickstarter campaign which enabled the release of 100 physical copies, and over 14,000 sales globally.

Only one physical copy remains, package #69, and it's on the auction block: [url=https://www.ebay.com/itm/354301415126]https://www.ebay.com/itm/354301415126[/url]

The production papers are also exclusively available [url=https://victorian-clambake.itch.io/tcs-papers]here on Itch.io[/url] if you'd like to see behind the curtain a little and support my work further!

[h1]Victorian Clambake[/h1]
Since creating this whimsical name and sprinting naked into the wilderness with a blindfold on, Victorian Clambake has achieved two game releases on Steam, two game jam releases, and organizing a community of like-minded nautical nerds on [url=https://discord.gg/clambake]Discord[/url].

All I can say is... God, what a waste of time this all was. 
[i]I'm just yanking yer yardarm.[/i]

[h1]Believe you me, the plans aren't about to end.[/h1]
It's been a year of insanity and instability, my life has changed dramatically and what remains of the studio is currently in a pile of plastic bins but that's not what you care or about and it's not going to hold me back.

[h2]Behold my next solo project![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30575242/0f8c8964074131a62f88ccb526236ff5991e17a1.jpg[/img]

I've been working on another title for the past three years in tiny bursts of inspiration and next month I'll release the Steam page!

The lads on [url=https://discord.gg/clambake]Discord[/url] know more and have seen gameplay, you should be like the lads, join the server.

[h2]But wait! There's MORE![/h2]
I've been pitching this idea for years but it wasn't feasible until now.

[h3]Victorian Clambake - Voyage Reports[/h3]
A development diary series released as monthly [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCszq4zo0dIe74sBWSzU5CBA]YouTube episodes[/url] to further grow our community, share my thoughts on games and development, and showcase the work that goes into creating a game!

They'll be short, fun, insightful, and coming next month if the wind is in our favor!

Keep your eyes on the horizon and sign up for the [url=https://victorianclambake.com/]newlestter[/url] or follow along on [url=https://twitter.com/Tophat_Scallop]Twitter[/url] so you don't miss a thing!

Fair winds to you all, I could have never made it this far without you.
 - Captain of Victorian Clambake, Evan Massie

notes.title: Limited Physical Run - Initial Timeline
notes.content:
[h1]Our final voyage together has begun lads.[/h1]

About a month ago I shared the news of our next title, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1395450/Shell_Shuffle/]Shell Shuffle[/url], along with my vision for a limited physical edition run of The Caribbean Sail. You've made your voices clear and the support we need is definitely here!

If you don't want to miss anything when the apocalypse inevitably occurs this winter and you repress every memory from 2020 then you need to join the Clambake Newsletter at the bottom of this page: https://victorianclambake.com/

Fore-warning; this read will be more dry than usual.

[h2]What is this all about?[/h2]
What began as a little test, turned into a black and white pixelated passion project that consumed three years of my life. Looking back on my work now has shown me how unbelievably large this game really is,  and it needs a proper send off celebration. I'll probably never be able to create another game like this.

My plan is to create and release a limited big box edition of The Caribbean Sail with the soundtrack and game on CD with a manual as was customary to old game releases. The perfect celebration of gaming and nautical history.

[h2]When? WHEN? WHEN!?!?![/h2]
Settle down there lads, I'm still a one man team when it comes to this project and I've barely begun the research. Winter is on the way and I don't want to compete with the holiday season or the Shell Shuffle development cycle. I'll need to have samples printed, CD's written, the manual designed, and other details sorted out before moving to production. Most important of all, the game will need to finally be gold mastered which means one final update. Can't update CD's after all.

Start stashing away your doubloons because I'll be coming for your coffers come springtime. I've decided to go with Kickstarter and the soonest possible time the campaign could be run is March 2021, don't take that as gospel though, it may not happen until even later.

I've been tallying up the costs and finding every corner I can possibly cut. I'll be manually assembling each package for shipment with my crew and sourcing each item from different manufacturers to get the best quality and value. Our minimum viable funding goal is currently $2,000 unless the manufacturing costs change.

After funding is complete, production will begin. Each piece will be manufactured and shipped to the Victorian Clambake studio for package assembly before being sent to those of you who become backers!
This may take anywhere from a few weeks to months so my best guess for the earliest time you can get your hands on a copy will be in June.

[h2]What will I get and how much will it be?[/h2]
[b]The base package will probably be $25 - $30*[/b]
- 
One game CD and one soundtrack CD
One Caribbean Sail game manual filled with game tips, history snippets, lore, jokes, mysteries, the secret recipe for hardtack, and maybe some shanty lyrics
One retro sized big box with the box art printed on the front and that classic carefree Victorian Clambake brand marketing fodder on the back

[b]Mid-tier package will probably be $50 - $60[/b]
- 
Everything in the base package along with a flag that has the emblem of a Caribbean Sail style historic pirate (like the wallpapers that come with the soundtrack) or the iconic TCS skull and crossed arms.

[b]Top-tier package will probably be $100[/b]
- 
Everything in the other two tiers along with an autograph from yours truly and something delicate that will be a real challenge for me to create. (I'll need to actually make one before I say more)

All of these packages and prices are prone to change. 
I'd like to have some game map posters printed too if I can ever find a decent value printer for them.

*(I'm either a product finance management logistics wizard, or I'm missing something huge because none of the special edition manufacturing companies thought I could get it done for less than $40 per unit without ordering thousands)

[h1]Summary[/h1]
Save some doubloons, [url=https://victorianclambake.com/]sign up for the newsletter[/url], come fund the campaign in March/April and receive your very own physical copy of The Caribbean Sail around June!

I can't quite express the feeling of seeing how enthusiastic your support has been!
The closest comparison I can make would be to say it's like sailing from London to Shanghai on a Raft and surviving.

Thank you one and all for your help on this long journey!
 - Your Captain, Evan

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30575242/3bb6bdff526b19f5698157f2d106e034029ed86e.png[/img]

[h1]Biggest Changes[/h1]

No matter how many times I said "No" to crew recruitment, you lads kept taking it as a "Yes, but no themed" so I added a Landlubber difficulty setting that will allow you to keep your save file when you die and find a crew recruitment opportunity in any pub. You'll be doing it at the cost of your ability to earn achievements though so HAH! THERE! WHO GOT THE FINAL WORD IN?

Bottles out for Globalstats.io lads. I've taken the bottle message system offline because the functionality was woefully limited and continually caused a rare crash that was unable to be fixed from my side, but, with the help of two jolly tars I was able to save, moderate, and manually implement 2890 user written bottle messages making your chances of seeing the same two messages as low as recovering from the plague. You can also still write new messages that will be added to your local pool.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30575242/5c756fc5766288635d50a25ff3d4cb706d14d87b.png[/img]

[h1]How to enable Fantasy Mode[/h1]

Start a new save file and turn the lantern green by clicking on it!

I wanted to maintain the realism of Purist Mode while allowing the madness of Fantasy Mode so that you can play the nautical experience you prefer! Development was like building a game inside of another game which has been a playtesting nightmare. I think I'll do something easier next time, like developing a game using only my nose while upside-down and blindfolded.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30575242/ff06565e5388e65aa530cb9b4e465b325c101238.png[/img]

[h1]What's next?[/h1]

First, fixing any and all bugs you can find. After that I'm going to work on getting a 64-bit Mac version running and I'll also try to get a more optimized version for everyone. I'll also be updating the screenshots and working on a new trailer.

If you haven't already, leaving an honest review on the store page or updating an old one would be really helpful since so much has changed. Once you've had some time to play, you'll realize it's not the game it used to be at all.

I hope that I was able to bring the joy of exploration and mystery back into the world I created for you.

Fair winds to you all!
 - Captain and Developer, Evan.

notes.title: Fantasy Toggle - Beta Beginning
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30575242/eae804b10113d896517f526355c9bd3c31f90153.png[/img]

[h1]Belay being bored because beta begins![/h1]
It's been over a year since development began on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/TCS/announcements/detail/1768130575204688104]Fantasy Toggle[/url] expansion and it's finally time to start testing. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30575242/437dc20f516abf1cde4b43997b15ae58bda6470c.gif[/img]

This megalodon can't wait to sink his teeth into your ship.

[h1]What's happening?[/h1]
As of today, the final preparations to release Fantasy Toggle are underway!
The game has become so internally complex that I've already got a list of known bugs to start fixing. Rather than making the beta public and wasting time responding to forum threads and bug reports, the beta will be done in stages.

I'm having my friends take the first trick at the helm so I can watch how they play in person and see what does and doesn't make sense to them. After the bugs they found are flogged to death and the necessary improvements have been made, I'll have a few specifically chosen lads help improve the grammar and playtest on multiple platforms.

After every problem we could find has been addressed, I'll be porting TCS from [b]GameMaker: Studio[/b] to [b]GameMaker 2[/b] and [b]The Caribbean Sailors[/b] crew of beta testers will be brought aboard to make suggestions, hunt for bugs, give feedback and give me my much needed ego petting.

If Fantasy Toggle can survive all of that then I'll know she's ready for the sea. 

That's probably not what you expected but it's better than watching her sink after the bottle christens her.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30575242/2cd31f8525d242a009c93274bbd73373ba2f3652.gif[/img]

Remember when this big boi sneaked into the game on launch day? His time to shine will come soon.

[h1]What's left to do?[/h1]
All of the content for Fantasy mode is nearly complete, but there's some polishing left to do.
New feature tutorials, gameplay balancing, achievements, fringe case scenarios that can leave you stuck or aimless, and other assorted little tasks to complete. Like adding more particle effects.

If you want to follow the progress, I'd recommend the official Victorian Clambake [url=https://discord.gg/clambake]Discord Server[/url] or [url=https://twitter.com/Tophat_Scallop]Twitter[/url].

[h1]WHEN WILL IT BE DONE???[/h1]
By the end of the month hopefully. 
There's a lot to take into consideration that I can't estimate. 
How many bugs will be found?
How hard will it be to port TCS through Game Maker 2?
How long will it take for Apple to approve the 64-bit Mac version?
What [i]does[/i] Jenkins do with all the empty turtle shells we catch?

What I can say for sure is that I'm working hard to make the best game I can, which means taking the time to get it right. That's what the giant mollusk running Victorian Clambake mandated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30575242/6a4ce7af958c3d91e54ba7288dd27f7807cb8bec.png[/img]

[i]Captain! A fire breathing ship is trying to ram us![/i]

[h1]What other words are you going to make me read in this long post?[/h1]
These ones, and the next ones; Over the weekend you'll be able to plunder yourself a copy of The Caribbean Sail for $2.99 which you won't see again for a long time. After the sale I'm raising the price to $14.99 to reflect the new value. It will literally be two games in one. 

After Fantasy Toggle, I'll have to "Gold Master" The Caribbean Sail and end development. Then I can release the soundtrack, make some merch, and see what else can be done with what I've created! It's been a long voyage but port is finally in sight.

Now it's time to head into the beta development storm.
 - Your Captain, Evan.

I said this in the last progress report and I'll say it again. Creating Fantasy Toggle has been comparable to creating a new game inside of an old game. Implementing new systems while maintaining old mechanics is like trying to sail a clipper ship against the wind- it's slow progress and things keep breaking.

Throw in the new Mac update demanding 64-bit binaries when GM:S 1.4 can only handle 32 and I've got a shark sized problem on my hands to bring the entirety of The Caribbean Sail into GameMaker 2 at some point. Like the lasers fired from the Cybership above, sometimes we miss our target.

After Fantasy Toggle is complete, The Caribbean Sail will be twice the game it is now!
This also means that I'll be increasing the price once again to reflect the new value.

There are more plans after Fantasy though! A soundtrack, merch, potentially a physical edition?! Time will tell but until then, I'll be at the helm of development!

Normally I spice up the patch notes with humor or poetry but if I tried to do that with this update log, it would be a full novel. I wasn't expecting this patch to be the size of a bloated whale and take an Atlantic crossing's worth of time to complete.

[b]These are the new features![/b]

On the first of April, I'll run a week long sale to celebrate our progress!

notes.title: Fantasy Toggle - Development Seamap
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30575242/eae804b10113d896517f526355c9bd3c31f90153.png[/img]

[h1]Freedom and fortune are fine for a time, but the devil awaits in the depths of the unknown.[/h1]

[h1][b]This is the seamap for Fantasy Toggle[/b][/h1]

I've held back the most creative ideas in favor of maintaining an accurate 1700's sailing experience. [u][b]That's about to change.[/b][/u]

Fantasy Toggle is the final major content expansion to The Caribbean Sail. It will be mysterious, dangerous, fantastic, free, and entirely optional. It will bring that sense of wonder and possibility from nautical mythology to life in the game.

[b]Here's the plan:[/b] A toggle will be presented to enable fantasy mode when you select an empty save slot. This will allow people who prefer the historically grounded setting to continue playing without any intrusions from the mythical.

[b]Disclaimer:[/b] Like the legends of old, some features may change.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30575242/d68be0b820d40ecd2fc64f690eeedcfd83d8d8af.png[/img]

[h1][b]The Charted Features[/b][/h1]

Though much is planned, many of the events and encounters would be better experienced than explained. Where's the mystery when you already know what you'll find? Instead, here's an overview of the types of content I'll be creating.
 
[h1]New Ports[/h1]
At least three new map locations that you'll have to discover before being able to set course for them.

[h1]Luck[/h1]
It won't have much impact on the likelihood your crew will become sick and die, but many of the new features had to depend on [i]something[/i]. It will reflect your relation with the sea itself and lead to some "interesting" scenarios.

[h1]Treasure Hunting[/h1]
Why trust banks when the ground is a perfectly safe place to keep money? I bury every penny I make from this game behind my house and it hasn't been stolen yet. It is really hard to find a buried penny though...

[h1]Unlockables[/h1]
There will be new professions and ships to unlock. You probably expected that, but what you didn't expect was the power of pistons! You'll be able to acquire a Steamship that isn't dependent on the wind... but you will have to pay for fuel.

[h1]Events[/h1]
As for the new encounters; You'll find sea monsters, ghost pirates, curses, events based off traditional nautical mythology and a few of my own!

[h1]Story Structure[/h1]
Though the current set year of the world will not change, it will be instantly apparent that things are different. Unlike the current main story, many opportunities will present themselves and allow you to decide your own  investment in them.

[h1]More Shanties[/h1]
Can you really ever have enough musical alternatives? I won't be satisfied until every inventory slot contains a shanty. 

[h1]Particle Effects[/h1]
Do you love particle effects? By George, I can't get enough of them. There will be new particle effects and they will be glorious.

[h1][b]Final Notes[/b][/h1]
I'm going to push one more patch before I dedicate to working on Fantasy Toggle. As with Route Planning, this will complicate the file too much to push in multiple patches so it all has to be completed as one massive update. 

I'd like to complete Fantasy Toggle in four months or less but it's impossible to know how long something will take when you're a solo developer.

If you have any questions, the forums are always open. If you'd like to say "Ahoy!" then climb aboard the [url=https://discord.gg/nkPXg8m]Community Discord.[/url] If you haven't already, do drop an honest review on the store page! They're encouraging and helpful as feedback. My gratitude! 

- Your Captain, Evan.

notes.title: V1.6.7 - I did Willy Whale today, thanks for asking.

[h1]Sometimes you get hooked on a passion project and can't stop yourself[/h1]

You know that whale you always see? Yeah, that one. You can finally catch him.

Next time you see the whale flaunting his fluke and spewing his spume "Go Fishing" and you'll spot that beautiful blowhole bobbing in the bay.

After attaching your harpoon to him, a new mini-game will trigger. All you have to do is click when the white line is over the red line. If you mess up too many times you'll never see him or your precious harpoon again.

I intended to work on other things this week but once I got started I simply couldn't quit. Making a (comparatively) huge new animated asset, new song, and new mini-game, took quite awhile. Whaling has been requested frequently enough to hopefully make the effort worthwhile.

Apart from whaling, a game crashing bug was fixed... and oh so very many new glorious particle effects.

notes.title: V1.6.6 Blasted Cannons
notes.content:
[h1]I took off my eye patch and my full attention is back on development. [/h1]

I've been doing some much needed cleanup within the assets in preparation for work on the expansion. You'd never believe how many cobweb.png and dust.gml files I had to clean off after spending a few months out of the deep resource code...

Combat has been re-balanced again. I had to plead with each nation to agree on tracking damage down to the decimal so upgrades would scale properly. They agreed on one condition; their ships begin with [u]slightly[/u] more health.

A quiet death on land in a warm bed with full belly was never meant for a true sailor! If you're not hungry, you're not dying while resting anymore. Now get back on the Ocean- [b]there are sharks that need to eat![/b]

Some of you have noticed that "[i]Me PiRaTeY gRaMmARGH[/i]" isn't quite what it should be. With the help of Aedyr, nearly all of the text has now been proofread and corrected. Buy him a round if you ever meet him. 

To help guide new players, I made the location halo for Nassau yellow on the map until you make port there once.

The [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/882870/Jolly_Riot/]Jolly Riot[/url] promo icon was changed to a pair of cutlasses. 

A few bugs nobody found were thrown overboard and replaced with particle effects.

notes.title: Pushing an update on a Tuesday... ah...
notes.content:
I'm glad to see you lads enjoying the trading cards. I haven't seen any potatoes  yet so which one of you has been hoarding them all? 

It's been a while since I pushed an update on a Tuesday... brings back scary sleep deprived memories from last week... or was that last night? It's hard to tell when you don't sleep most of the time. The point I'm eventually going to make is that I'm wrapping up the marketing and taking a break from the heavy development push I've been on until I can get more hours of sleep than you have living crew members after defeating the Baochuan. (Inconsistently 1-5)

[h1]On to the patch notes![/h1]

The pirates got their ship together- their Junk ship that is. You'll now encounter Junk ships of the piratical variety near Shanghai. Corsairs have become more common in the Indian Ocean but getting back to the patch notes; there's a higher chance you'll find Corsair ships while sailing around Cape Town or Calicut because they all want a piece of that [strike]booty[/strike] pirate treasure.

Oh, and about those ships- they now all scale HP a little with your cannon upgrades to make the upgrades less like tactical airstrikes and more like cannonballs again. All of the boss ships also saw some tweaking, but they're recovering quickly.

The pirate captains all simultaneously found their dice and cups so they can play Liar's Dice with you now.

Finally, apart from all the bugs that keep boarding my game despite being thrown overboard every couple weeks having been thrown overboard again; there's a new sound effect that plays when something is out of your price range- which won't help the deaf very much but they usually have more money since they don't blow it all on shanties.

I'll be up to my nautical shenanigans again soon enough.

Fair winds to you all!

notes.title: The Plan for Route Planning.
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30575242/5822f677c3bcda731ece0ab1ec5d21aa00f0ba67.png[/img]
[h1]Grab a bottle of your preferred beverage and get ready to sail wherever you want!

[b]Today I share with you my seamap for Route Planning![/b][/h1]

One of the main features I wanted since conception of the game was the ability to plot your own course. While designing it, I realized the changes would be a massive addition that could take months to complete. 

I could easily turn that into DLC but I've always been of the mind that purchasing a game means purchasing the [u]FULL GAME[/u]. That's why all updates, content, and expansions including this one will be [b]FREE[/b].

Now, that  isn't to say that new content is worthless. I'd like to set a new price that reflects the value of the game once the expansion is completed and implemented. This will be an open discussion I'd like to have with current players on the forums. Now on to the plans!

[b]Disclaimer:[/b] Some features are prone to change.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30575242/8a56355d5a1ea0085f34765333da0665c27068a0.png[/img]
[h1]Your map has contracted chickenpox[/h1]

The most important feature of course, will be the new locations available from your map! 

Here are the currently planned new locations.
[list]
    [*]Ponta Delgada, Azores
    [*]Reykjavik, Iceland
    [*]Lisbon, Portugal
    [*]Las Palmas, Gran Canaria
    [*]Cape Town, South Africa
    [*]Long Island, New York
    [*]Belém, South America
    [*]Kozhikode, India
    [*]Shanghai, China
[/list]

Each location will have new artwork, music, trade values, and other unique features. The voyage will also be unique and different for each destination you sail to. "That's all exciting but what's the point?" I hear you say.

The initial goal will still be to reach Nassau, but after surviving your first voyage some lite questing options will be presented that lead to adventures all over the world! Bounty hunting, smuggling, and the extremely enticing delivery of telegraphs will be the first optional quests I work on.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30575242/86e322d5a00de70ac535065dab69ef6d87eb3868.png[/img]
[h1]Ooo! Shiny new buttons![/h1]

The map and shop will stay the same. Each port will have new people that ramble at you and unique liars dice opponents in the pub. The logbook will be accessible from port so you can dispose of unwanted items and check on your current condition. You'll be able to wait at port for crew to become well again. The Shipyard will be a new tab where you can purchase a ship, repair your ship, upgrade your ship, and careen your ship to scrape barnacles off the hull and improve sailing speed!

[h1]Gameplay changes and features[/h1]

Three profile slots will be introduced to save your progress and give more focus on your captains development and story. Profiles will be erased on the death of your captain so you better stock up on medicine!

Ships will remain unlocked permanently across all profiles and some upgrades like reloading time and disease resistence will be added.

Crew relations will become important as time is spent sailing the ocean and their resentment grows for your cruel hand that flogs them. Treat them well or face mutiny at gunpoint.

New fish, weather, and events will be added to keep the world alive- and out to kill you. Get ready to be impaled by a Narwhal!

More particle effects. Many new particle effects.

Shanties... Watch closely for the coming anouncement :)

Finally, feast yer eyes on these fine new ships!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30575242/894e0a66d29fba874535103aaa8b6074a48fa08e.png[/img]

I hope this answers some questions and gets you as excited as I am!
 
 - Your Captain, Evan.

The game is pretty solid right now, it's nearly bug free and has as many particle effects as I could fit in- so the weekly updates are over. There will be one more content patch and then i'll focus my efforts on the free Route Planning expansion.

My thanks to each and every one of you jolly tars that support me and my game. We've come a long way and have so much farther to go. Good health and fair weather to you all as we sail into the new year!

- The Captain, Evan.

notes.title: Thirteenth week update: Full sail ahead!
notes.content:
[h1]It's finally here![/h1] You can finally ram any ship in the game at full speed with the Raft! You can also ram using any of the other ships but I know what you real hardcore players were waiting for- and yes, it probably will sink your Raft if you attempt it. Simply click "Full Sail" while in combat to initiate the ram, and if you get cold feet hit "Half Sail" to pull back. The acceleration speed of your ship is determined by that ships maximum speed and the damage is determined by the size of your ship... and theirs.

I've had a few reports of a rare bug that crashses the game when it fails to retrieve online data, I've tried to ad an extra safety net but can't be positive it will work since I can't recreate the bug myself. If anyone encounters this bug please paste your crash log on the forum or email it to "ContactClambake@gmail.com"

Christmas is close and the seasonal easter eggs are in so don't forget to down a pint of dice at the pub and listen to the holiday banter after the 23rd. 

[b]YO HO HO![/b]

notes.title: Twelfth week update: IT'S A MAN O' WAR
notes.content:
Yet another miracle of pixel art and code wizardry has been performed and in about a days time I've been able to bring you another update!

Three new ship variants have been added as random encounters for your pleasure and torture! 

[b]The Cutter:[/b] a small and quick vessel. 

[b]The Schooner:[/b] a large and fast ship with few cannons... and 

[b]The War Galleon:[/b] a massive ship with unreasonable hull integrity and enough cannons to sink anything in a few seconds- to give players a sense of accomplishment. 

Trying to bring it down with a frigate has been the most fun I've had while playing yet. I can't wait to improve on the combat even more!

Another update to make use of those new ship types, changes the "Avoid" button to "Flee" in those awkward situations where your ship wore an English flag to a Spanish party. The final change lowered the spawn rate of crates... also I think some more particle effects got added to the game somewhere.

Enjoy your new enemies! :D

notes.title: Ninth week update: Controller Support
notes.content:
Let's get straight to the updates.

The default names auto clear while your unique names can be changed without being completely rewritten. French and Spanish ship's captains are less shy and will talk to you now. When apples spoil they are no longer thrown overboard but are added to your inventory so you can force your crew to eat them anyway! The sloop's hull integrity was debuffed to balance the small hitbox that made it almost impossible for enemies to hit. A badge link to the Victorian Clambake twitter account (@Tophat_Scallop) was added to the main menu- plugo plugo.

The biggest update this week is gamepad support. The game wasn't designed to be controlled by a gamepad but there have been a few requests and even I'd like to play it from the couch. I've rewritten as much of the button code as I could do without rebuilding the entire game (No joke). The second hardest part was trying to fit a virtual keyboard in for writing crew names and bottle messages. Xbox controllers work and your PS4 controller will probably work.

[b]So here's how it works:[/b] Use the analog sticks to move the cursor and the right shoulder buttons or "A" as a left click on any screen. The d-pad can be used for swapping characters and ships on the start menu, and portion control while sailing. The d-pad can also be used in battle for aiming the cannons and "B" can be used for firing them. You can pause the game any time during play with the "Start" button. The virtual keyboard isn't great but it can get the job done, some helpful alternative keys for typing are "Y" for space, "X" for delete, and the left analog button or left trigger for capitalization. 

I know it isn't great but I just didn't consider controller support until far too late- I won't be making that mistake again on my future games. Thank you for the support and I hope you enjoy the updates as development continues!

notes.title: Eighth week update: Patching with Pitch
notes.content:
I've been building a lot of content for the expansions in the background while working on these updates and soon the time will come when weekly updates stop and I begin working on the "Route Planning" expansion. I'll share more details soon!

notes.title: Seventh week update: War of the Pixel Succession
notes.content:
Welcome aboard sailors!

Since the sale and update last week, I've seen an Ocean of new messages in bottles. They always make me laugh when play testing so I've decided to start posting my favorites to the Victorian Clambake twitter: @Tophat_Scallop

Another week another update!

Tired of being a loyal Englishman? No more must you serve the Queen! After raiding a ship you can now take their flag and fly it proudly! Use the new Spanish, French, Danish, Dutch, and Pirate flags to show your true colours or just trick the enemy into letting you board. The way ship encounters work has been changed so you can use your spyglass (Now given to you from start) to determine the approaching ship's banner and then raise your own. Use this to board the French ships or just gain first strike in battle. Pirates still don't care who you are and will attack anyway. Also, more particle effects.

Being such a big and complicated update accounting for so many different combinations of ship types and flags, I wasn't able to ad Spanish, Dutch, or Danish ships yet- but i'm working on it! 

There have been quite a few bug fixes this week too. The apples are no longer so terrible they somehow make scurvy occur sooner. You can't surrender your sinking ship. You can catch the fish from the frenzy event in the net. A few other small bugs which I brushed under the rug and hopefully nobody will trip over... I MEAN FIXED! Yeah I definitely fixed them.

 -Side note, I'm using Google Translate to have the dialogue of ship captains be in the appropriate language, I'm well aware the translations may be inaccurate so if someone has a correction then call it out in the forums for me. Thank you!

notes.title: Fifth week update: Hauling in the features!
notes.content:
Sorry to string you along another day. I was at the end of my rope last week while caught up in making a net. The tensions are still high as I haul in another line of updates.

[h1]There's now an inventory system![/h1] I built it from the ground up the past couple weeks along with these items available from the shop:

[list]
    [*]The Trawling Net - Physics enabled and perfect for catching fish with minimal effort.
[*]The Spyglass - More of a placeholder for a later update but you can stare at the water in a whole new way! You can also see the whale and land I guess but that's nowhere near as cools as the water.
[*]Fishing Bait - Toss it into the water to summon the hordes! Here's a tip for those of you who persevere through my loquacious updates: If you see little dark fish swimming in the ocean, go fishing when they're below your ship for a special event- use fishing bait when above them to catch enough fish to sink a Sloop.
[*]Barrel of Apples - If your crew is dying of scurvy it's probably too late- you should have thrown an apple at their head when you had the chance.
[*]Shanties! - This may be the most important update of all: [b]TWO NEW SONGS HAVE BEEN ADDED SO WE NO LONGER MUST LISTEN TO "DRUNKEN SAILOR" ON LOOP UNTIL WE DIE.[/b]
[/list]

There are more items planned and half finished but I didn't want to postpone the update another week and I needed some feedback on it, so have some patience and expect more great things!

There were also some small changes and fixes like the "Reel it back" achievement now showing your highest streak and... something else but it's nearly 2 AM and i've been working so hard i've forgotten.

I keep saying things like "Calmed down" and "Taking some rest" but considering how hard i'm still working, I somehow started to believe that working for 12 hours a day is rest- compared to 19 hours though, I suppose it is.

notes.title: Third week update: Preparing for more
notes.content:
It's been a stressful first three weeks but things have calmed down as I've patched out the last few bugs and discrepancies found. This means I can start designing and building content for "Route Planning" and share the details with you all when ready.

There are still a few updates i'll implement while preparing the framework for the expansion so this week you'll find a completely redesigned logbook, it now has an index with five sections: Crew Log, Ship Log, Supplies, Journal, and Inventory. The journal is more of a personal notepad for you that is saved between voyages. The inventory tab is empty right now but necessary for preparation of new items that will help you on your journey in an update soon. 

The Frigate art was redone (again) to have two masts and be less of an eyesore. Hull depth of large ships was changed for accuracy and reefs are less dangerous now- but still deadly. I corrected the terminology as to no longer call St. Georges Cross a Union Jack. (Dev Tip: Write dialogue after making the art)

A lot of behind the scenes work is going on but you'll see more updates next week!

notes.title: Second week update: Leaky but moving
notes.content:
After a hectic first launch week I've taken some time to rest, plan ahead, and do some important code clean up for the expansions. I've also made a few updates worth mentioning.

Continuity has been improved by making it rain during battles or reef crossings when appropriate, praise the rain! No longer will you have to be confused about the currency you're using because i've extended the font library and changed "E" to "£" - they were pounds all along! Not the weight, the UK currency. To my surprise, the lowest achieved achievement is still "Reel it back" so get out there and catch 100 fish with one harpoon without taking a break! I added an achievement stat counter for it- but Steam updates it rather slowly.

I've enjoyed reading all your messages in bottles! Plenty of messages even saltier than the water they're in but it's really spiced up play testing. One day, our 8-bit ocean will just be a surface of bottles and corpses border to border.

- ON ANOTHER NOTE - 

A friend and I participated in the Gamejolt Dreamhack Jam and made a game in 48 hours. It's called "Captain Cutter's Last Stand" - a punchy melee combat game where your goal is to survive as many waves of Squid's as you can. It's completely free so if you'd like, check it out: https://gamejolt.com/games/Cutterslaststand/286681

notes.title: First week update: fair weathered launch
notes.content:
You asked for it, I delivered!

Messages in Bottles can now cross over between players! You MUST opt-in by going to settings and enabling online bottles. This was one of the trickiest features to make and may need work but with a large player base now, i'm sure you'll help me find any problems in no time.

Another change has been to the profession menu, no longer must you dream of what the glorious pixelated face of a fisherman looks like- You can view every occupation and it's perks in the menu! Not enough? Well now you can be a Surgeon! 

The RNG also had a few small adjustments to lessen the absurd Influenza epidemic during storms along with more common food spoiling and battle injuries. Wondered what your hull integrity was while sailing? It's been added to the logbook and while at very low hull integrity the leaks will continue on main sailing screen- that won't get annoying for Raft sailors i'm sure. Defeated ships will have more than just food now, sometime's they'll have cannonballs or harpoons.

The feedback has been fantastic and I love hearing what you all have to say! Lot's of great ideas.
